shell_commands_self_reported.command: cd <WORKSPACE>/app && find . -mindepth 1 \( -name .git -o -name node_modules \) -prune -o -print | sort && echo ---- && find . -type f -not -path './.*' | wc -l && find . -name '.*' | sort

for f in $(find . -type f | sort); do printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$f" "$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' ')" "$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' ')"; done; echo ----; for f in $(find . -type f | sort); do tail -c1 "$f" | od -An -c | grep -q '\\n' || echo "no trailing newline: $f"; done

find . -type f | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do b=$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' '); l=$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' '); n=$(tail -c1 "$f" | od -An -c | tr -d ' '); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$f" "$b" "$l" "$n"; done

python3 -I -c "
import os
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.'):
    for name in sorted(files):
        p = os.path.join(root, name)
        data = open(p, 'rb').read()
        print(p, len(data), data.count(b'\n'), 'eol' if data.endswith(b'\n') or not data else 'NO-EOL')
" | sort

wc -c -l assets/logo.svg build/bundle.js data/shipments.csv docs/overview.md pack.ignore package.json poetry.lock src/config.py src/depot_notes.py src/generated/manifest_pb.py src/main.py src/server.py src/utils/dates.py src/utils/text.py tests/test_text.py
